about: The broom's hall (docs/milestones/crypt-rework.md, CR7): a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones hanging in the dark, its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall). The Old Broom keeps the middle of its hall swept: dust over the whole hall, then a swept ring of clean stone with the strokes of its bristles round the middle, the dust left lying in drifts round it and against the slab's edge; no pit (the boss never falls); bays where the slab runs out; the floor pushed out round every spawn, pillar, heap and decal. tools/ground_shape.py draws boss_broom_ground.tscn and its art from this.
